lesson_title: Posting: The Month Finds Its Way Home
hook_text: Your books can balance perfectly and still be wrong. Here's what the trial balance really proves.
clip_script: Two honest warnings about the scales, so you never over-trust them. Level scales cannot see a filing error: slide the rent into the Repairs drawer — wrong drawer, correct side — and the scales stay level, wrongly. And they cannot see what never arrived: forget a transaction entirely, both halves missing, and level they remain. The scales test the WEIGHING, not the FILING. But when the scales DON'T level, they whisper what went wrong: a gap equal to one of your amounts — something was dropped once; a gap that halves neatly — something sat on the wrong side; a gap divisible by nine — two digits swapped places somewhere.
visual_style: A giant balance scale stacking glowing account balances on each pan, then error scenarios flashing past while the scale stays eerily level.
pacing: Confident build, twist in the middle, rapid-fire diagnostics at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to post a whole month and prove it.
